calculate_fal_ai_image_cost: calculate the cost of fal.ai image generation given a model name and image response
get_fal_ai_model_info: get model info for a fal.ai model including cost per image
validate_image_response_type: validate that an image response is of type ImageResponse before calculating cost
count_generated_images: count the number of images in an ImageResponse data array
compute_total_generation_cost: compute the total cost by multiplying cost per image by the number of generated images
